full_judgment: 7. It is further stated that lmanullah and Amina Khatoon took 9 years "Meyadi Kolkarsha pattan" from the auction purchaser Rupsha Fakir measuring an area of 69 decimals of land by executing and registering a Kabuliat dated First Srabon, 1326 BS and paid rent to Rupsha Fakir by holding over after the expiry of the term of alleged Kabuliyat; that later Rupsha Fakir transferred 91.50 decimals of land in favour of defendant No. 19, Abdul Sabur Howlader by a kabala dated 10 Srabon, 1344 BS corresponding to 23-7-1937 from CS khatian No. 30 bearing CS plot Nos. 201 and 202; that he amicably got possession from CS plot No. 202 and defendant No. 19 had been possessing that kabulati land that Imanullah got 69 decimals of land by pattan from auction purchaser Rupsha Fakir; that Imanullah died leaving defendant Nos. 19 to 22 as his heirs and thus defendant Nos. 19 to 22 got 69 decimals  9-1/2 decimals totaling 1.60-1/2 aores of land and had been possessing the same with the other co-sharers and also paid rents.
